jobs.title: Consultant, Product Management
jobs.description:
Consultant, Product Management
Join Dell Technologies’ Unstructured Storage Team and help define the full-stack infrastructure powering the next generation of artificial intelligence. Working across the PowerScale, ObjectScale, Lightning File System, and Exascale Storage portfolios, you will collaborate with the world’s leading AI organizations to translate ambitious goals into scalable, production-ready solutions. This role is ideal for someone energized by emerging technology and comfortable shaping both the strategic product vision and the detailed solution architecture required to bring it to life.
What you’ll achieve:
You will operate from 30k feet down to ground level—evangelizing Dell’s vision for AI infrastructure, whiteboarding architectures with customers, and diving into the technical details of storage, networking, and compute. You will guide customers through complex or still-evolving requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop complete rack-level designs that account for performance, capacity, resiliency, connectivity, power, and operational needs. Success requires equal parts technical depth, curiosity, customer empathy, and the ability to create clarity where the path forward is not yet fully defined.
Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a  Consultant  on our  Product Management  team Seattle, WA or Santa Clara, CA.
Take the first step towards your dream career
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:
Essential Requirements
- Hands-on experience designing or deploying AI, machine learning, or high-performance computing infrastructure
- Understanding of AI data pipelines, including data ingestion, preparation, training, checkpointing, inference, and long-term retention
- Strong knowledge of scale-out file, object, and distributed storage architectures
- Ability to turn ambiguous customer needs into clear requirements and actionable solution designs
- Confidence engaging with technical practitioners, architects, executives, product teams, and engineering organizations
- Ability to communicate a compelling product and technology vision while remaining credible at a deep technical level
- Strong troubleshooting, benchmarking, and proof-of-concept skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts
- Willingness to learn quickly, experiment with emerging technologies, and work effectively across organizational boundaries

Desirable Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
- Familiarity with Dell PowerScale, ObjectScale, Lightning File System, or Exascale Storage technologies
- Ability to develop rack-level designs, including component selection, cabling, port mapping, power, cooling, and capacity planning
- Experience sizing solutions based on workload profiles, performance requirements, growth expectations, and resiliency objectives
- Strong whiteboarding, architecture-diagramming, and technical presentation skills
- Experience integrating storage, high-speed networking, servers, GPUs, and orchestration platforms into complete solutions
- Knowledge of Ethernet and InfiniBand networking, including topology, bandwidth, latency, congestion, and redundancy considerations

About Dell Technologies — ISG Developer Experience
Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group is a global leader in Solutions, Storage, Compute, and Networking. The Developer Experience organization within ISG is responsible for developer productivity, tooling, observability, and platform engineering for approximately 9,000 engineers. Our current mandate spans agentic SDLC transformation, AI tooling governance, and the operating model changes required to make AI-assisted development the norm — not the exception.
Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)  builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.
Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.
Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.
We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.
If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.
Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology
Compensation
Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $201,480 to $277,035
Benefits and Perks of Working at Dell Technologies
Your life. Your health. Supported by your benefits. You can explore the overall benefits experience that awaits you as a Dell Technologies team member — right now at MyWellatDell.com
You will:
- Own product area backlogs and requirements; prioritize for impact.
- Prototype, experiment, and validate hypotheses with customers.
- Plan launches and coordinate cross-functional readiness.
- Ensure analytics, accessibility, and performance standards.

jobs.title: Observability Product Manager
jobs.description:
Observability Product Manager
Para impulsionar a inovação no desenvolvimento de produtos na Dell Technologies, precisamos de pessoas com visão de futuro em nossa equipe de Gerenciamento de Produtos de TI. Como parte dessa equipe, desenvolvemos estratégias de produtos e soluções, definimos roadmaps de produtos e buscamos oportunidades no mercado para garantir que nossas ofertas maximizem a lucratividade e permaneçam competitivas.

Junte-se a nós como Observability Product Manager na equipe de Gestão de Produto em Eldorado do Sul/RS para realizar o melhor trabalho da sua carreira e gerar um impacto social significativo.
O que você irá conquistar
Como Gerente de Produto de Observabilidade, você será responsável por definir e executar a estratégia e o roadmap de produtos de observabilidade para ambientes corporativos. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes de engenharia, arquitetura, operações, vendas e sucesso do cliente para entregar capacidades de observabilidade que proporcionem visibilidade de ponta a ponta em sistemas distribuídos, aplicações e infraestrutura, atendendo às necessidades dos clientes e às oportunidades de mercado.
Você irá:
- Definir e executar a estratégia e o roadmap de plataformas de observabilidade, incluindo métricas, logs, rastreamento distribuído e eventos, garantindo alinhamento com os requisitos dos clientes, prioridades de negócio e tendências de mercado.
- Coletar e analisar requisitos de clientes, realizar análises competitivas e de mercado, identificar oportunidades de aprimoramento de produto e traduzir necessidades dos clientes em funcionalidades e capacidades de produto.
- Definir, priorizar e gerenciar funcionalidades de produtos de observabilidade, incluindo integração com OpenTelemetry, pipelines de dados de telemetria e recursos de observabilidade para IA, com base no valor de negócio e impacto para o cliente.
- Atuar em parceria com equipes de engenharia, arquitetura e operações para garantir a entrega bem-sucedida dos produtos, definir prioridades de implementação e promover a adoção de padrões de observabilidade em toda a organização.
- Desenvolver estratégias de go-to-market, mensagens e posicionamento de produto para soluções de observabilidade, além de capacitar as equipes de vendas e sucesso do cliente a comunicar efetivamente o valor dos produtos.

Dê o primeiro passo rumo à carreira dos seus sonhos
Cada membro da Dell Technologies traz algo único para a equipe. Veja o que procuramos para esta função:

Requisitos Essenciais
- Inglês avançado/fluente
- Experiência em gestão de produtos em ambientes de software corporativo, incluindo soluções de observabilidade, monitoramento ou DevOps.
- Conhecimento aprofundado de conceitos de observabilidade, incluindo métricas, logs, rastreamento distribuído e plataformas modernas de observabilidade como Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Datadog e Elastic/ELK.
- Sólida base técnica com capacidade de compreender e comunicar conceitos complexos relacionados à telemetria, pipelines de dados, sistemas distribuídos e padrões da indústria, como OpenTelemetry, convenções semânticas e estratégias de coleta de telemetria.
- Histórico comprovado na coleta de requisitos de clientes, tradução desses requisitos em requisitos de produto e entrega de soluções centradas no cliente.

Requisitos Desejáveis
- Conhecimento de estratégias de observabilidade nativas para IA em ambientes produtivos, incluindo plataformas como Langfuse, LangSmith e Arize.
- Graduação completa

jobs.title: Consultant, Product Management
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - PowerFlex

Join us as a Senior Product Manager - PowerFlex on our Product Management team in Israel to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact.

What you'll achieve

As a Senior Product Manager for PowerFlex, you will own the product roadmap and business requirements for PowerFlex data path and connectivity solutions, driving strategy and execution from concept through delivery. You will collaborate closely with architecture, engineering, and strategic partners such as Broadcom/VMware to translate market and customer requirements into engineering deliverables that bring customer-critical capabilities to life.

You will:
- Own the PowerFlex Data Path Strategy: Manage data path strategy and execution for PowerFlex, including the NVMe/TCP roadmap, working with architecture on spec updates, ecosystem growth, and partner relationships.
- Drive Product Roadmap & Requirements: Develop and maintain the product roadmap, write detailed business requirements and specs, prioritize features and specifications while applying budget, timeline, and resource constraints.
- Manage Strategic Partner Relationships: Own the Broadcom/VMware relationship for all storage connectivity initiatives, fostering ecosystem growth and alignment.
- Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work extensively across functional areas — including Engineering/R&D, Product Marketing, and BU Leaders — gathering inputs, updating product plans, and communicating the impact of product decisions to all stakeholders.
- Evaluate Market Opportunities: Conduct in-depth market analysis, lead business cases for optimization of existing solutions and next-generation products, and identify new growth areas and emerging technology opportunities.

Take the first step towards your dream career
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here's what we are looking for with this role:

Essential Requirements
- 5+ years of software product management experience with a proven track record of managing products through their entire life-cycle.
- 3+ years of storage data path experience, with strong technical depth in storage connectivity and data path technologies (e.g., NVMe/TCP).
- Proven track record of interfacing with demanding customers to refine business requirements, prioritize backlog, and translate market needs into engineering deliverables.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to work across Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and executive stakeholders.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Desirable Requirements
- Experience with Dell ISG technologies such as PowerFlex, VxRail, or related storage/HCI platforms.
- Experience managing partner/vendor relationships in the storage ecosystem (e.g., Broadcom, VMware).

Experiência em Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management ou Software Program Management, conduzindo produtos, plataformas ou serviços em ambientes globais.

Perfil pragmático e orientado por dados.
